intent: Proposed text or code edits you accept or reject in place: unified, split or inline phrase diff, always with + / − marks, then one line.
useWhen: an agent proposes an edit to a file or a paragraph
accept or reject hunks before they land
show that a proposal went stale
doNotUseWhen: approving one command or whole action — ApprovalCard
a review tool across many files — not in kit, ask

lines.note: { type: "context" | "add" | "remove", text, oldNo?, newNo? }[] for unified and split.

status.note: accepted and rejected render one line.

onAccept.note: Accept, the one solid primary. ⌘/Ctrl+Enter in the card.

requirements: added and removed lines carry + / − marks and say Added / Removed to screen readers
inline edits use del and ins
Escape rejects and ⌘/Ctrl+Enter accepts while focus is in the card; buttons carry aria-keyshortcuts
stale disables the actions and says why
once resolved, focus moves to the one-line row

doNot: Do not invent a local DiffView, PatchCard, or SuggestionCard
Never show a change by colour alone; keep the + / − marks
Accept is the one solid primary
snippet: <InlineDiff title="Proposed edit · calcTotal" file="src/billing/invoice.ts" hunkHeader="@@ -41,2 +41,3 @@ calcTotal" lines={lines} hunkLabel="1 of 2 hunks" onAccept={accept} onReject={reject} onAcceptAll={acceptAll} />
